stories.title: The Governance Gap in Open-Weight AI and What to Do About It
stories.description: Lower costs, data privacy, and greater control are driving open-weight AI adoption, but many organizations are not addressing the risks that come with it.

stories.title: Hackers Turn aNotepad Into a Malware Delivery Channel for XenoRAT and NodeLinkRAT Backdoors
stories.description: North Korean hackers abuse aNotepad to control infected PCs and swap XenoRAT for NodeLinkRAT targeting South Korean security experts.

stories.title: N-able Confirms Server Breach, Disables Mail Assure and SpamExperts Management Access
stories.description: N-able confirmed unauthorized access to one server in its Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud environment and disabled management access across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

stories.title: Splunk Patches Nearly 140 Flaws Across Three Core Products
stories.description: The security updates resolve critical and high-severity issues leading to authentication bypass, remote code execution, and privilege escalation.

stories.title: F5 Patches Critical NGINX2Root Flaws as PoC Exploits Go Public
stories.description: The five NGINX2Root vulnerabilities could allow remote, unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code.

stories.title: Ubiquiti Warns of Critical UniFi Access Flaws Enabling Root Code Execution Attacks
stories.description: Ubiquiti disclosed seven UniFi Access flaws, including a critical bug allowing low-privileged users to execute code.

stories.title: Hackers Target European Commission with ARTEX AI Tool in Major Cyberattack
stories.description: A cyberattack on the European Commission disrupted staff services for more than 10 days, leaving some employees unable to submit timesheets, request leave, or enter salary information.

stories.title: Hackers Breach N-able Cloud Server, Disrupting Email Security Management Across 3 Regions
stories.description: N-able confirms unauthorized server access disrupted Mail Assure and SpamExperts management services, with no evidence of customer data compromise.

stories.title: Java4Shell Exploitation Attempts Begin as Vendors Rush Out Advisories
stories.description: GreyNoise, WatchTowr and Cloudflare report probing and exploit attempts, while Cisco, Elastic, Red Hat and Siemens detail impact.

stories.title: Ruby Releases Fixes for 7 Regex and String Flaws, Warns 5 Have Proof-of-Concept RCE
stories.description: Ruby patched seven memory-safety flaws, including five with remote code execution PoCs, in regex handling and string case conversion.

stories.title: Researcher Demonstrates Database RCE Exploits Affecting PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle
stories.description: Researcher demonstrates database RCE exploits in PostgreSQL, MySQL and ClickHouse, plus an unauthenticated Oracle chain; no attacks observed.
